scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is Jura Crest Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

story: From Lyss it runs 319 km to Lyss; allow about 5 h 30 of riding. The stops in between: Pointe de Montbec I, Corcelettes Les Violes, Les Roseaux and Littoral de Chens-sur-Léman. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from Switzerland into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
